name: Den Mar Corporation
old_description: As a family-owned business since 1971, we’ve built a reputation for delivering exceptional custom stainless steel products and services. Our team of skilled craftsmen and state-of-the-art equipment ensure that every project meets the highest standards of quality and timeliness. Based in Dartmouth, MA, our 56,000 square foot facility is your one-stop shop for all your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Den Mar Corporation operates from a 56,000-square-foot facility in North Dartmouth, Massachusetts. The company was founded in 1971 and has remained family-owned since its inception, building a reputation around custom stainless steel fabrication.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication services under one roof. Its capabilities include MIG and TIG welding supplemented by robotic welders for production runs, laser cutting with two CO₂ lasers and a 10,000 kW Bystronic fiber laser offering an 80-by-160-inch cutting envelope, metal forming on multiple CNC press brakes that handle sheets up to 14 feet long, and in-house powder coating to finish parts without outsourcing.

Den Mar serves a mix of residential and commercial customers across several sectors. The company explicitly lists food service, healthcare, and hospitality among the industries it supports, alongside broader residential and commercial project work.

The business positions itself as a one-stop shop that eliminates the delays of third-party finishing vendors. It emphasizes that no job is too small and highlights the scale of its fiber laser — described as one of the largest and most powerful in New England — as a differentiator for meeting tight deadlines.
